Electric Buses to Ply in Four Chhattisgarh Cities

Preparations are underway to launch 50 electric buses in Bhilai-Durg, a move expected to provide relief to 20 lakh residents. Across Chhattisgarh, 240 electric buses are planned for deployment in four cities: Raipur will receive 100, Bhilai and Bilaspur will each get 50, and Korba will be allocated 40.
